title: dbd2netcdf: Convert Slocum glider Dinkum Binary Data files to NetCDF and CSV
description: Command-line tools for translating the Dinkum Binary Data (DBD) files produced by Teledyne Webb Research Slocum gliders into NetCDF or CSV. Handles the full DBD family (dbd/ebd/sbd/tbd/mbd) together with their LZ4-compressed *.?c? variants, and shares a sensor cache across files so multi-file deployments convert in a single pass.
